middlewares.name: Python log parser
middlewares.handlerTsCode: (line: Message): Message => { const originalJson = line.json_content; const clean = (typeof line.content === 'string' ? line.content : JSON.stringify(originalJson || {})).replace(/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m/g, '').trim(); const sourceFile = (line.origin?.file || 'unknown').replace(/^.*[\\/]/, ''); const sourceComponent = /^vfs-dms-local\.log$/i.test(sourceFile) ? 'tunnel' : (/^(wfx-|progress-debug\.log$)/i.test(sourceFile) ? 'tc-wfx' : (sourceFile.replace(/\.(stdout|stderr)\.log$/i, '').replace(/-debug\.log$/i, '').replace(/\.log$/i, '') || 'unknown')); const pad = (value: number, length = 2): string => String(value).padStart(length, '0'); const formatDate = (date: Date): string => `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}:${pad(date.getSeconds())},${pad(date.getMilliseconds(), 3)}`; if ((originalJson && typeof originalJson === 'object') || clean.startsWith('{')) { try { const payload: any = originalJson && typeof originalJson === 'object' && typeof originalJson.msg === 'string' ? originalJson : JSON.parse(clean); if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && typeof payload.msg === 'string') { const eventDate = typeof payload.time === 'string' ? new Date(payload.time) : new Date(line.ts); const ids = ['request_id', 'session_id', 'tunnel_id'].filter((key) => typeof payload[key] === 'string' && payload[key]).map((key) => `${key}=${payload[key]}`); const correlationId = typeof payload.correlation_id === 'string' ? payload.correlation_id.slice(0, 8) : '-'; line.json_content = { correlation_id: correlationId, timestamp: formatDate(eventDate), level: typeof payload.level === 'string' ? payload.level : 'LOG', component: sourceComponent, message: payload.msg + (ids.length ? ' ' + ids.join(' ') : '') }; line.order_key = eventDate.getTime(); return line; } } catch (_) {} } const correlation = clean.match(/(?:^|\s)correlation_id=([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27})(?:\s|$)/i); const correlationId = correlation ? correlation[1].slice(0, 8) : '-'; const app = clean.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2},\d{3})\s+(DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL)\s+(.+?):\s+(.*)$/); if (app) { line.json_content = { correlation_id: correlationId, timestamp: app[1], level: app[2], component: sourceComponent, message: app[4] }; line.order_key = Date.parse(app[1].replace(' ', 'T').replace(',', '.')); return line; } const server = clean.match(/^(DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL):\s*(.*)$/); const date = new Date(line.ts); const received = formatDate(date); line.json_content = server ? { correlation_id: correlationId, timestamp: received, level: server[1], component: sourceComponent, message: server[2] } : { correlation_id: correlationId, timestamp: received, level: 'LOG', component: sourceComponent, message: clean }; line.order_key = line.ts; return line; }
